chunks: From him, from Safwan and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام about qunut in all five salat (prayers), and he said: Perform qunut in all of them.
He said: Then after that I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, and he said: As for those in which you recite aloud, then do not doubt about it.

key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: supplicatory devotion recited in salat (prayer) at the designated place

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about qunut in the five daily salat (prayers)?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of qunut within the five daily salat (prayers). Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام instructs that qunut is to be performed in all of them, while Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام emphasizes it particularly in the prayers of audible recitation.
